data.body: [P2] Preserve the public record shape. Existing Java 21+ consumers using seven-component record patterns fail recompilation after this upgrade; the added compatibility test explicitly asserts that failure. Retaining constructors and documenting the boundary does not preserve source compatibility, and equality/hash semantics also change. Keep the seven-component record and carry the snapshot through separate immutable hook metadata, such as a new default hook overload that delegates to the existing hook.
